answers.assumption_check: Measured 2026-11-13 on akiendell under ~/.cairn/venv (Python 3.14): skill_block's proofs run 12 red, 47 green, from three causes. (1) skill_block.py _berth_key (line 462) and _idea_berth (line 473) take a berth pointer as a path only when it starts with '/', so every Windows berth (C:\...) is dropped: berth_ticket_cursors returns {} and the review lane drains nothing; 9 teeth of test_review_lane_drains_by_measurement.py red on it. (2) test_skill_block.py's CLI children write stderr in the console code page (cp1252, where the em-dash is byte 0x97) and the proof decodes utf-8, so the reader thread dies and r.stderr is None: 2 teeth red with TypeError. (3) test_the_wire_is_not_fatal_when_the_ROOTS_are_unwritable locks the root with chmod(0o500), which does not stop a write into a directory on Windows, so a berth is written and printed: 1 tooth red. Load-bearing: Path(v).is_absolute() is true for C:\... on Windows and for /... on POSIX, so accepting a leading '/' or an absolute Path keeps every POSIX pointer and adds the Windows ones; 'none, because ...' is neither.

All are in the decisions.
